cache_policy: C and H are both fresh processes; OS and general kernel caches retained. Analytic colliders require no cooking. H adds a completed matching preparation. C is not disk-cold or compiler-cold.
timeout_definition: 180 s per process, including post-timing audits and teardown; timeout stage recorded; capacity is within this startup budget, not an unconditional GPU memory limit
notes: N is num_envs, one rigid body per arena; one declaration replicated through each platform public scene API
Each independent process must return finite state [num_envs,1,13] and audit arena/instance counts
Only S shared-source homogeneous arenas. Old U varied objects within one arena, excluded from this workload
Media is separate, 16 arenas and native cameras; it does not measure headless startup
Original single-env outputs and profiling remain historical; no cross-protocol speed ratio
measurement: headless physics-ready, no cameras, rendering disabled
